skill.name: outlook-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Microsoft Outlook, names Outlook for mail, calendar, client-setting, or archive work, or needs to choose among the checked Outlook connectors, sandbox files, My Browser, Outlook Desktop, and guidance. Routes triage and search, new drafts or sends, bounded calendar operations, preservation, signatures, organization, PDFs, local archives, and version decisions while separating code-shipped handlers from current account availability and operation proof.
skill.userDescription: Organize Outlook mail, calendars, archives, and email workflows.
exampleQuestions: Create a triage workflow for my Outlook inbox.
Help me organize an Outlook calendar for a project.
Explain how to archive and preserve Outlook mail safely.
